newsitem.title: USA: Atlas Copco buys 99 pct of Prime Service.
newsitem.headline: Atlas Copco buys 99 pct of Prime Service.

text.p: Atlas Copco AB unit Atlas Copco North America Inc said Tuesday it has purchased 99 percent of the outstanding shares of Prime Service Inc.
The companies said the shares were purchased pursuant to a USD 32 per share cash tender offer commenced on June 9, 1997.

Consistent with a previously announced agreement, the Prime Service shares not acquired by Atlas Copco in the tender offer will be converted into the right to receive USD 32 in cash per share in a merger which is expected to be completed within a week.
Following the merger, 100 percent of the outstanding shares of Prime Service will be owned by Atlas Copco.
All necessary approvals for the acquisition have been granted.
